deadline.value: Students wanting an assistantship should apply by Dec. 15; later applications are considered if assistantships remain.
deadline.quote: Students who want to be considered for an assistantship should submit their application by Dec. 15

supervisor.value: Applicants are advised to contact faculty whose research matches their interests early in the process.
supervisor.quote: they should identify and correspond with faculty members whose area of research matches their interests early in the application process

funding.value: Assistantships go to applicants who apply by the priority deadline; the page does not promise funding to every admitted student.
funding.quote: For priority consideration for a graduate assistantship, apply by the program admission deadlines listed

entry_route.value: Applicants can enter from a bachelor's degree (36 credits) or a master's degree (preliminary exam in the first spring).
entry_route.quote: students who enter the program with a master’s degree are required to take the written preliminary exam the first spring semester

also.quote: The program for the Doctor of Philosophy in Biology degree requires a minimum of 36 credits, when pursued from the baccalaureate

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.
